body: A fan showed up a full day early for J. Cole’s new sneaker, so Cole personally pulled up to show him love A REAL ONE! The Dreamer Indie 5000 marks Cole’s first independently developed sneaker following his previous partnership with PUMA. Five years in the making, the shoe features an Italian-made cupsole and made its hometown debut today in Fayetteville, North Carolina, the same day Cole returns home for The Fall-Off Tour.

source_caption_text:
A fan showed up a full day early for J. Cole’s new sneaker, so Cole personally pulled up to show him love 🥹❤️ A REAL ONE!

The Dreamer Indie 5000 marks Cole’s first independently developed sneaker following his previous partnership with PUMA. Five years in the making, the shoe features an Italian-made cupsole and made its hometown debut today in Fayetteville, North Carolina, the same day Cole returns home for The Fall-Off Tour. 

Supporting the vision before the doors even opened—and Cole made sure that love didn’t go unnoticed. What a real one 💯
